ordered_text_segments.text: Identified monthly waste across 4 routine patterns. Recoverable with minor adjustments.
Baseline draw while the house rests
Plug into a smart strip to auto-cut phantom draw while you sleep.
Shift thermostat up 2°F between midnight and dawn to
Idle draw detected during vacant hours
Enable automatic standby socket shutdown when your phone leaves geofence.
Activate Vacation or Eco-away schedule to delay cycle until 4 PM return.
Grid surge pricing windows (4 PM – 8 PM)
Pre-chill the house to 70°F before 3:30 PM off-peak rates expire.
Delay timer set to 9:00 PM saves up to $18/month on heavy high-amp appliances.
Consolidate into full loads and utilize Eco Cold Wash mode.
Adjust fridge to 37°F and freezer to 0°F to retain freshness and reduce compressor burden.
